WMT.thesis_one_line: World's biggest store chain is adding ads, memberships and online sales, but today's share price already assumes growth far above what it can deliver.
kill_criteria: Walmart U.S. comp sales (ex fuel) below 2.0% for two consecutive quarters (release "Walmart U.S." table).
FY27 adjusted EPS guidance cut below its current low end, quoted "$2.80 to $2.87" (guidance table, any quarter).
Free cash flow (operating cash flow less capex, release) below $10B for FY27 (FY26: $14.9B).
Consolidated total debt (release footnote 2 definition) above $65B at any quarter-end (31 Jul 2026: $57.2B).
Adjusted operating income growth (cc) below 2.0% in Q4 FY27 (Q3 guide, quoted: "adjusted operating income to grow 2.0% to 4.0%").
key_adverse_facts: Q2 FY27 operating income +28.8% included about $2.9B of one-off tariff refunds recorded as a reduction to cost of sales (10-Q, quarter ended 31 Jul 2026); refunds are being reinvested in price in H2
FY27 adjusted EPS guide raised only to $2.80-$2.87 (midpoint +$0.035) after a Q2 beat of about $0.08 vs guide midpoint; implied H2 EPS about $1.365 vs $1.36 prior year (flat)
H1 FY27 FCF $5.5B vs $6.9B; capex guide raised to about 4.0% of net sales from 3.5%; short-term borrowings $10.5B vs $3.8B a year earlier

Open matters: Spark Driver FTC order (Mar 2026, $100M judgment, ~$37M accrued) and further driver suits; Asda equal-value claims (~77,000 claimants, hearing from 2026-11-23); money-transfer grand-jury subpoenas
data_conflicts: d4 FCF yield 0.83% (Yahoo TTM FCF $7.1B) vs release-based FY26 FCF $14.9B and H1 FY27 FCF $5.5B; I normalised to $14B
Yahoo total debt $75.1B includes operating leases; release total debt $57.2B excludes them
Triage Q02 cited 34.7x NTM P/E and 0.8% FCF yield: confirmed as d4 outputs, not independently re-derived
WMT.confidence_in_thesis: med: business quality and guidance record are verified in primary filings; the verdict rests on valuation inputs (normalised FCF base, 8% discount rate) that are judgements

valuation_view_vs_v1.reconciliation: No V1 row exists. Reverse DCF at 8% implies 22.3% 10-year-path FCF growth (17.8% at 7%; 13.5% even if FCF equalled adjusted net income) vs my base 9%, above my 12% bull case.

WMT.scenario_basis: FY27 adjusted EPS $2.835 (guide midpoint) grown 5%/9%/12% for 3 years, exit NTM P/E 22x/28x/33x vs 34.7x now, dividends $0.99 growing 4%, price $107.98 at 2026-09-25

COST.thesis_one_line: Members-only warehouse chain with loyal customers and steady 6-7% underlying sales growth, but the share price already assumes much faster growth than that.
kill_criteria: Adjusted total-company comparable sales (ex gas and FX) below 4.0% for two consecutive quarters (Q4 FY26: 6.7%).
U.S./Canada membership renewal rate below 91.5% (Q4 FY26: 92.3%) or worldwide below 89.0% (Q4: 89.8%).
Paid-membership growth below 2.0% year over year (Q4 FY26: +3.8%).
Reported gross margin (supplemental) below 10.75% in any quarter (Q4 FY26: 11.02%).
Quarterly membership income growth below 4.0% (Q4 FY26: +7.3%).
key_adverse_facts: Q4 FY26 EPS $6.75 included a non-recurring $0.15 benefit from IEEPA tariff refunds net of partial reinvestment; excluding it EPS grew 12.4% (supplemental, 8-K 2026-09-24)
Membership income growth decelerating as the 2024 fee increase annualises: +14.0% in Q1 FY26 to +7.3% in Q4 FY26
Four putative class actions (Stockov, Gower, Ortiz, Briggs) seek refunds of tariffs passed through to members (10-Q Note 8, filed 2026-06-03)
No numeric guidance given in any of four releases opened; FY26 balance sheet is unaudited and marked subject to reclassification (10-K pending)
data_conflicts: d4/Yahoo FCF $6.22B (1.52% yield) vs release FY26 FCF $9.39B (operating cash flow $15,825M less capex $6,435M)
d4 eps_fy0 $22.78 is FY27 (Aug 2027); FY26 actual EPS $20.76 reported 2026-09-24 after d4 estimates were set
Triage Q02 cited 40.2x NTM P/E: confirmed as a d4 output
COST.confidence_in_thesis: med: operating quality verified in primary releases; valuation verdict depends on my 8% discount rate and 9% base growth

valuation_view_vs_v1.reconciliation: No V1 row exists. Reverse DCF at 8% implies 18.3% FCF growth for five years (14.0% at 7%; 16.2% on net income) vs my base 9% and bull 12%.

COST.scenario_basis: FY26 underlying EPS $20.61 (GAAP $20.76 less $0.15) grown 6.5%/9.5%/12% for 4 years to FY30 EPS, exit NTM P/E 26x/33x/38x vs 40.2x now, dividends $5.88 growing 12%, price $922.77 at 2026-09-25

CRL.thesis_one_line: Animal-and-lab safety testing for drug developers: demand is recovering and legal clouds are clearing, but the price already assumes a big profit rebound.
kill_criteria: Organic revenue growth below 0.0% in Q3 2026 or Q4 2026 (Q2 2026: +0.1%).
FY2026 non-GAAP EPS guidance cut below the current low end, quoted "$11.15 - $11.45".
Non-GAAP operating margin below 18.0% in Q3 or Q4 2026 (Q2 2026: 20.5%).

Consolidated net debt (consolidated total debt and finance leases per 10-Q acc. 0001100682-26-000118 Note 12, less consolidated cash and cash equivalents) above $2.8B at any quarter-end (27 Jun 2026: about $2.45B).
Any accrual, judgment or settlement above $100M disclosed for the securities class action in 10-Q Note 16.
key_adverse_facts: FY26 non-GAAP EPS guide $11.15-$11.45 vs H1 actual $5.08 implies H2 about $6.07-$6.37, up to +32% on H2 2025 ($4.82)
Securities fraud claims over NHP import disclosures revived by the First Circuit on 2025-08-15; case back in D. Mass.; exposure not estimable (10-Q Note 16)
GAAP losses: Q2 2026 EPS $(0.03), H1 divestiture loss $181.7M; Q4 2025 impairments $211.0M plus goodwill $165.0M
Debt $2.64B (revolver $1.12B) after $507.3M Cambodian NHP supplier purchase; H1 FCF about $134M vs about $282M; net debt about 2.9x Yahoo EBITDA
data_conflicts: Triage Q07 'ongoing DOJ investigation' conflicts with the 2026-02-18 release: 'now concluded U.S. government investigations'; underlying resolution document not opened
Triage 'motion to dismiss largely denied Aug 2026' conflicts with 10-Q Note 16: First Circuit reversed in part on 2025-08-15
Triage 'revenue declining -2.7%' is reported growth after divestitures; organic growth was +0.1%
Q2 non-GAAP EPS $3.02 includes a $0.19 deferred-compensation gain the company says is largely offset by tax for the year
CRL.confidence_in_thesis: low: demand recovery is real in filings, but the verdict hinges on an unproven H2 EPS ramp, a high-beta stock and unresolved class-action exposure

valuation_view_vs_v1.reconciliation: No V1 row exists. Reverse DCF at 8% implies 13.1% FCF growth for five years (9.0% at 7%; 16.7% at 9%; 9.6% on non-GAAP net income) vs my base 9% and bull 14%. [DV11 2026-10-06: discount rates of 7-9% are below the CAPM cost of equity of about 11% (5.17% + 1.4 x 4.14%); at a consistent WACC of about 10.0% implied growth is 19.9% on the $450M FCF base and 23.8% after deducting $83M TTM SBC; implied_vs_base stays above.]
